refill.title: Keep your meeting alerts up to date
refill.body: Open MeetingGuard so it can schedule your next alerts.

settings.voiceNeedsApp: The voice readout plays inside the app. On Android the full-screen alarm opens the app and reads the meeting out; on iPhone, open the alert to hear it. With the app closed, the notification sound rings first.

imported.label: Events from other calendars
imported.description: Meetings that come from your phone calendar, Google or Outlook: birthdays, holidays, invitations. All-day events never ring. A meeting's own setting still wins.

followUp.label: Post-meeting follow-ups
followUp.description: 5 minutes after a meeting ends, get follow-up ideas from the AI assistant.

briefing.label: Daily briefing
briefing.description: Once a day, a short summary of that day: your meetings and the tasks that are due.
briefing.fullScreenHint: At the set time, the briefing takes over the screen like a meeting alarm. Needs the full-screen permission (see Alert delivery below). Android only.

statusNotification.label: Status notification
statusNotification.description: Keep a permanent, silent notification showing that your alerts are armed and when the next meeting is.

exactAlarms.granted: Exact alarms are allowed. Alerts ring right on time.

fullScreen.title: Full-screen alarms
fullScreen.description: With maximum intensity, meeting alarms can light up and take over the screen even while the phone is locked.
fullScreen.denied: Full-screen alarms are turned off, so maximum alerts arrive as regular notifications.

dnd.title: Do Not Disturb
dnd.androidDescription: Maximum alerts can ring during Do Not Disturb only if you allow it: open the settings of the maximum alerts and turn on "Override Do Not Disturb".
dnd.iosDescription: To get alerts during a Focus, add MeetingGuard to the Focus's allowed apps in Settings > Focus.
dnd.open: Allow maximum alerts to override Do Not Disturb
